description: Repository identity rename manifest. The engine (rename/rename.mjs) reads this file; all name knowledge lives here, never in the script. Rule templates like {{lowercaseName}} render `match` against identity CURRENT values and `replace` against NEW values (falling back to current for fields with no new value — such spans are claimed but left unchanged and reported as pending decisions). Reusable for future renames: after a successful rename the tool rewrites identity.current, so the same rules keep working.

displayName.notes: Product/display name: prose, docs, portal copy, cli-commands.json title.

lowercaseName.notes: Lowercase identifier: CLI command, bin entry, filenames, localStorage keys, hooks, skill dirs, usage strings.

uppercaseName.notes: Env-var prefix family (ROBOREPO_*), portal window global, MANAGED_BY file name.

packageName.notes: npm package identity. Renaming it orphans existing installs (they keep working but stop updating): publish the new name, `npm deprecate` the old one. Unset = left unchanged, reported as pending.

configDir.notes: State dir fragment under $HOME (~/.roborepo). Deliberately NOT derived from lowercaseName: existing installs hold real state there (see backCompat), so it changes only when explicitly set.

repoUrl.notes: GitHub repo identity inside canonical repository IDs and test fixtures. Change only when the GitHub repo itself is renamed.

schemaDomain.notes: Externally-owned schema $id domain (scripts/harnesses/provider-manifest.schema.json). Claimed so the sweep never touches it; changes only if you own the replacement domain.

rules.note: npm identity: package.json, package-lock.json, uninstall paths, release scripts/tests. Claiming the WHOLE package string prevents the sweep from partially renaming inside it.

Managed-copy notice shipped into harness homes; filename is content-addressed in manifests/platform/manifest.tsv (rename file + manifest rows in lockstep; add a cleanup row for the old name). This is deliberate display branding — the product name belongs in it.
ALREADY DE-BRANDED (phase 1b): the portal token meta name + X-Cli-Portal-Token header are now name-agnostic. Rule kept as a claim-only guard for any stragglers.
Custom DOM event fired by portal/shared/theme.js.
localStorage key for portal theme. Only persisted data affected: users' saved theme resets once.
window global injected by portal-server.mjs, read by portal/shared/{theme,api}.js.
Whole ROBOREPO_* env-var family in one rule (claims only the prefix span). Users' shells and external tooling may export these — see backCompat.
~/.roborepo path fragment (sorted after ownership-marker, which is longer, so markers are never mangled). Pending unless identity.configDir is explicitly set.
Canonical repository IDs (git:github.com/...) track REAL external repos. Claimed so the sweep never mangles them; replaced only when identity.repoUrl gets a new value.
Externally-owned schema $id domain. Not identity-derived on purpose: edit this literal manually if the domain ever moves.

sweep.note: Case-variant sweep over the lowercase name (RoboRepo/Roborepo/roborepo/ROBOREPO), applied to UNCLAIMED spans in live files only. Any other case arrangement (e.g. RoBoRePo) is ambiguous and requires --ack.
sweep.note_mapTitleCaseToDisplay: The single-word title-case variant 'Roborepo' maps to the new displayName (same treatment as 'RoboRepo').

exclusions.historicalNote: Dated records and design artifacts stay as-written, like git history. Per user decision (Sep 2026): ALL of docs/plans is excluded, active plans included — the rename tool ignores it entirely.
exclusions.generatedNote: generated/ is committed build output. Regenerate from source after a rename (config apply / rules-render in a dev checkout) rather than hand-editing — or pass --include-generated to force-edit.

apply.note: Tracked files/dirs whose PATHS contain a replaced token are git-mv'd (bin/roborepo, docs/user/reference/roborepo*.md, skill dirs, symlinks).
apply.note_symlinkAware: .claude/.codex/.gemini skill symlinks have their LINK TEXT rewritten, never followed.

backCompat: PERSISTED STATE: existing installs have real state under ~/.roborepo. Simplest strategy: migrate-on-first-run in scripts/cli/roots.mjs (if the new dir is missing and the old exists, rename it). No parallel-path compat layer.
NPM PACKAGE: renaming packageName orphans existing installs. Strategy: publish the new name, `npm deprecate` the old one pointing at it.
GLOBAL BIN: after a package rename, old `roborepo` symlinks remain in user PATHs; scripts/install/uninstall-lib.sh must recognize both layouts during uninstall.
ENV VARS: users' shells and external tooling may export ROBOREPO_*. Keep ROBOREPO_STATE_ROOT readable as a fallback for one release if zero-user-action migration matters.

APPLIED HARNESS FILES: MANAGED_BY_ROBOREPO.md and rendered hook/permission files already live on user machines. Use manifests/platform/manifest.tsv cleanup rows (existing pattern) to remove old names on next apply.
TELEMETRY: machine-local registries carry git:github.com/kirinmurphy/roborepo repo IDs. Repo IDs must NOT change (they track real repos).

NOTE (Sep 2026): the .roborepo-managed ownership marker (now .builtin-managed), the generated policy filename (now generated-permissions.toml), the write-guard hook filename (now write-guard.mjs), and the XDG PID path (~/.local/state/cli) were de-branded in phase 1g — no longer part of any rename.
